The boundary between the white frosting and the cake base is slightly blurred and indistinct, suggesting a minor fusion artifact where the two materials should have a sharp physical edge.
The vertical lines of the window frame in the background show slight warping, not perfectly straight, which is common in AI-generated architectural elements.
